about.title: Passionate About the Power of Language
about.bio1: With over a decade of experience as a Spanish Language Specialist, I've dedicated my career to the art and science of communication. From the lecture halls of Madrid to boardrooms in New York, my work has spanned continents and cultures.
about.bio2: I hold a Master's degree in Applied Linguistics from the Universidad Complutense de Madrid and am certified by the American Translators Association (ATA). My passion lies in not just translating words, but faithfully conveying meaning, tone, and cultural nuance.
about.bio3: Whether you need a precise legal document translated, engaging Spanish content created, or a tailored language coaching program, I bring meticulous attention to detail and genuine enthusiasm for every project.

services.title: Comprehensive Language Services
services.subtitle: Tailored solutions for every linguistic need
services.service1Desc: Precise Spanish ↔ English translation for legal, medical, technical, and marketing documents with cultural localization that resonates.
services.service2Desc: One-on-one and group Spanish lessons tailored to your level — from conversational fluency to business-level proficiency.
services.service3Desc: Professional consecutive and simultaneous interpretation for conferences, legal proceedings, and corporate meetings.
services.service4Desc: SEO-optimized Spanish content, blog posts, and marketing materials crafted to engage native-speaking audiences.
services.service5Desc: Meticulous review of Spanish texts for grammatical accuracy, stylistic consistency, and cultural appropriateness.
services.service6Desc: Strategic guidance for businesses entering Spanish-speaking markets, including cultural sensitivity training.

experience.title: Professional Experience

experience.job2Desc: Designed and delivered curriculum for 200+ students annually. Achieved 95% student satisfaction and 30% faster-than-average proficiency attainment.
experience.job3Desc: Provided translation and interpretation for law firms, hospitals, and media companies. Built a client base of 50+ repeat clients.
experience.job4Desc: Collaborated on multilingual projects for EU institutions and international NGOs. Specialized in technical and humanitarian documentation.
